The Art Of The Leprechaun: Fractal Calculus – 𝔖

description:
Abstract and Scope

Alpha↔Omega Dynamics (AΩD) is a relational temporal form of the Stokes cut. Release v40.04r03 opens the Manual I/Main Foundation Doctrine and Manual-II D.E.C. Reporting Overlay Plan AUTHORING lane. Axiomatic-Fundamentalism calculus (AFC) and Alpha↔Omega Dynamics (AΩD) remain source-bound inputs. Manual I/Main define tick-oriented measured time, tau_cycle as native phase-cycle coordinate, pi as tau_cycle / 2 display coordinate, declared coordinate/report-map discipline, and SPARC as a 2D observable-data fixture under declared projection/readout policy.

The Application Manual: Reference Implementation Layer

Manual II / Fractal Fusion Scales applies the doctrine through a D.E.C. report-coordinate and error-budget overlay while preserving Circle One-Metre Null-Path Report Cards, one-metre/null-path report-card records, Elementary Matter 118, Molecular Matter, Hydrogen/Cs scaffolds, and closed target/SI/metric/residual/score lanes. The carried finite fixture still records w=(1,1,4,2) and Pslide display notation as inherited source-contract scaffolds.
